class.name: TractionServer
class.brief_description: The electrical topology of the overhead traction wires.
class.description: Kept apart from the rendering of the wires, the same split [TrackServer] has against the track rendering. Ports [code]Traction.cpp[/code] and [code]TractionPower.cpp[/code] of the original engine: named power sources feeding wire spans, a resistive network built once per scenery load ([code]traction_table::InitTraction()[/code], including the pass that feeds a section's open end from the powered span it hangs beside), and the geometric "which wire is above this point" query ([code]scene::basic_cell::update_traction()[/code]). Not ported: [code]TTraction::PowerSet()[/code]'s section-marker replacement ([code]Traction.cpp:747-806[/code], only relevant when a sectioning cabin sits between two differently named substations) and [code]update_traction()[/code]'s pantograph-horn lateral tolerance.

method.name: network_build
method.description: Resolves named power sources (auto-creating one from a wire's own nominal values when the name matches none - [code]traction_table::InitTraction()[/code]'s fallback, [code]Traction.cpp:704-721[/code]), connects wire endpoints into a network and propagates source and resistance outward from every directly powered wire. Called once per scenery load, after every wire and source of that load exists.

method.name: power_source_create
method.description: Creates a traction power source - a substation, or a section of the network.

method.name: power_source_get_rid_by_name
method.description: The power source of [param name]; an empty RID for none.

method.name: power_source_set_nominal_voltage
method.description: The nominal voltage of [param power_source] [lb]V[rb] ([code]TTractionPowerSource::VoltageSet()[/code]) - what a scenery [code]voltage[/code] event changes.

method.name: power_source_set_params
method.description: Sets what the scenery declares of [param power_source] ([code]TTractionPowerSource[/code], [code]TractionPower.h:48-59[/code]): its name, nominal voltage [lb]V[rb] and frequency, internal resistance [lb]Ω[rb], the most current it puts out [lb]A[rb], its fuses (the fast one's timeout and repetitions, the slow one's timeout [s]), whether it takes recuperated energy back, whether it was made up for a wire's name, and whether it is only a section of the network - feeding nothing by itself, its spans powered through the network from a substation along it ([code]TTraction::PowerSet()[/code], [code]Traction.cpp:460[/code]).

method.name: wire_draw_current
method.description: The other half of [code]TTraction::VoltageGet(u, i)[/code]: the load drawn from [param wire] in this tick, which the sources feeding it count on their next tick. Called once per collector per step, with the same arguments as [method wire_get_voltage].

method.name: wire_find_above_with_height
method.description: Which wire span passes above [param position], seen from a pantograph whose plane [param up], [param forward] and [param left] span, with a slider [param width] wide and horns [param horn_width] past it - as [code]{rid, height}[/code]. [code]height[/code] is INF when no wire is found - the original's own "no wire in reach", which the raise simulation relies on to keep extending the pantograph to its joint limit.

method.name: wire_follow_above
method.description: Where a pantograph already on [param from_wire] is now, as [code]{rid, height}[/code]. Running off the end of a span is not a loss of contact: the spans are a doubly linked list and the original steps along it until the point falls inside one ([code]vehicle_table::update_traction()[/code], [code]DynObj.cpp:8742-8770[/code]). An invalid [code]rid[/code] means the chain ran out or the wire left the collector's reach sideways - the original's own signal to search the area instead ([method wire_find_above_with_height]).

method.name: wire_get_voltage
method.description: The reading half of [code]TTraction::VoltageGet(u, i)[/code]: the voltage on [param wire] for the sources' load of the previous tick. [param assumed_voltage] is the vehicle's own previous reading, used only to derive an equivalent load resistance - the same relaxation the original uses - and [param current] the instantaneous draw.

method.name: wire_set_parallel
method.description: The span [param wire] shares its running with, by name, as the data declares it ([code]TTraction::hvParallel[/code]). [code]"none"[/code] and [code]"*"[/code] mean the author knows there is one but did not name it.

method.name: wire_set_params
method.description: Sets what the scenery declares of [param wire]: its two ends, the name of the power source feeding it, its nominal voltage [lb]V[rb], its greatest current [lb]A[rb] and its resistivity in Ω/km, as a scenery declares it (0.01, the old default, is taken as 0.075, [code]Traction.cpp:107-110[/code]).
